title: iosanthus toxicarius
intro: Iosanthus toxicarius, commonly known as Yellow Gentian or Yellow Gentian shrub, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is a shrub native to tropical Africa, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The health benefits of Iosanthus toxicarius include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can be used to treat various ailments such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Iosanthus toxicarius include gentiogenic acids and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as stimulating digestion and treating gastrointestinal disorders.
